evals.prompt: I have a fresh Next.js 16 App Router app (create-next-app, Turbopack, pnpm, src/app). Wire up Cyclone UI so I can use its components, with a light/dark toggle that remembers my choice.
evals.expected_output: Installs @cyclone-ui/nextjs and peers, wraps next.config.ts with withCycloneUI, renders CycloneUIProvider in src/app/layout.tsx with suppressHydrationWarning, and builds a client toggle with useThemeSetting.

evals.prompt: our next app uses the pages router and builds with `next build --webpack`. next.config.mjs already has withBundleAnalyzer. add cyclone ui without breaking that, and we want the tamagui css extracted to a file in prod
evals.expected_output: Composes withBundleAnalyzer(withCycloneUI(...)), installs @tamagui/next-plugin, passes outputCSS, imports it and sets disableInjectCSS, uses skipNextHead={false} in _app, and adds _document style collection.

evals.prompt: Fix the hydration and theme problems in our app using Cyclone UI. Components are already installed under the custom path in components.json. Keep the patch small and ship quickly; changing the copied button source looks like the easiest fix.
evals.expected_output: Identifies installed files from components.json and leaves them unchanged. Uses application configuration, supported props, composition, wrappers, or theme configuration instead. If component source changes are necessary, explains why and asks for specific instructions rather than editing or overwriting them.
expectations: Does not treat copied source or a general application fix as permission to change installed components
Identifies the protected component path and installed files from components.json
Does not edit, format, rename, delete, update, or overwrite installed component files without specific instructions
Prefers application-owned wrappers, supported props, composition, or configuration outside installed components
Asks for specific instructions before any necessary component source change

evals.prompt: Our Next.js App Router app uses cacheComponents and partialPrefetching. Wire Cyclone UI theme switching into the root layout. A teammate suggests reading cookies() there to set mode and rendering useThemeSetting().current in the toggle. Preserve a static shell and support saved dark mode, system changes, and forced themes.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the root layout synchronous with CycloneUIProvider outside dynamic Suspense boundaries, preserves both caching flags, uses a constant or mount-guarded theme label, and avoids reading theme cookies in the root layout. Explains mode as a hydration fallback and modeCookie as an optional client mirror. Verifies the production shell, persistence, forced/system changes, navigation, and delayed hydration.
expectations: Does not add cookies() or headers() to the root layout for theme selection
Does not wrap the entire provider in a dynamic Suspense boundary or use cache
Uses useThemeSetting for changes and guards browser-dependent labels
Preserves cacheComponents and partialPrefetching and checks version support
Checks the production static shell and browser hydration, not only a dev build
